Description
The R&S ESW26 extends the ESW platform to 26.5 GHz, adding YIG preselector filtering above 8 GHz and support for external harmonic mixers via the optional B21 LO/IF interface. It is suited to conducted and radiated EMI testing across CISPR bands B through E and beyond, including automotive and aerospace frequency ranges.
All core receiver features of the ESW8 are retained — TDS modes, 21-filter preselector below 8 GHz, preamplifier, optional LNA — with the addition of the APC 3.5 mm (SMA-compatible) RF input 1 connector appropriate for the extended frequency range.
